sourceFile: 47. TIU L5S3-01 R Report test F-PCB PRESS JIG cutting 0.1mm to improve NG Frame deform -  date 2026.01.02_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft is not verified because it misidentifies the changed factor and mispairs the Line L normal control.
issues: Changed factor should be JIG cutting/test versus Normal, not Normal versus Line R/Line L.
Line R and Line L are subgroup keys, not changed conditions.
Line L function comparison uses the Line R Normal row instead of the Line L Normal row.
Measurement outcome from the header row is invalid and should be removed or rebuilt from data rows.
Result test rows are post-change validation only and lack a Normal baseline.
correctionPlan: Set baselineCondition to Normal and changedCondition to JIG Cutting 0.1mm or JIG Test.
Move Line R and Line L into subgroup keys and preserve separate line comparisons.
Pair Line R JIG Test with its Normal row and Line L JIG Test with its Normal row.
Remove the header-only measurement outcome unless actual data rows support it.
Classify rows 16-17 as non-comparative post-change frame deform/F-PCB separate results.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Citations exist but are insufficient because key grouping and row pairing are wrong.
